explanation.explanation: For the next 14 days, the forecast predicts a steady 195 units per day of demand for SKU S001::P0017. To keep a 90 % service level, the plan calls for ordering about 103 units at a time (the optimal order quantity). Safety stock of roughly 92 units is kept to guard against any unexpected spikes, because safety stock is sized by demand variability rather than just lead time. The reorder point is set at 1,566 units, so when inventory falls to that level, a new order will be placed before stock runs low. Compared with previous analyses, the safety stock and order quantity remain consistent with the SKU’s typical variability, keeping the expected total cost at $390.03.
